mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(i.quantity * m.price), 0) FROM scm_inventory i LEFT JOIN scm_material m ON i.material_id = m.id

SELECT mat.name AS materialName, SUM(inv.quantity) AS totalQty FROM scm_inventory inv LEFT JOIN scm_material mat ON inv.material_id = mat.id GROUP BY inv.material_id, mat.name HAVING SUM(inv.quantity)<20;
